# Button

Square, flat CTA for briefs, proposals and carousel end-cards ("Submit your request here", "Reach out to us →").

`InfoquestDesignSystem_80b250.Button` · Core

## Notes

Square, flat call-to-action. Primary = Infoquest purple; inverse = white hairline frame for aurora backgrounds. @startingPoint section="Core" subtitle="Square CTA buttons" viewport="700x220"
